descriptionHtml:
ضمان عام من الوكيل



**Rapoo MT760M Rechargeable Multi-Mode Bluetooth Wireless Mouse - Full Specifications**


**Brand:** Rapoo

**Model:** MT760M

**Type:** Wireless Multi-Mode Mouse

**Color:** Black 


**Connectivity:**

Bluetooth 5.0

Bluetooth 3.0

2.4GHz Wireless (nano USB receiver)

Up to 5 devices (switch between them)

Wireless range: Up to 10 meters (33 feet)

Nano USB receiver included (stored inside mouse)


**Sensor:**

PAW3220

DPI levels: 800 / 1200 / 1600 / 2400 / 3200 / 4000

DPI switch button: Yes

Tracking speed: Up to 30 IPS

Acceleration: 10G

Polling rate: 1000Hz wireless..125Hz bluetooth

  • Buttons: 10 total buttons, including primary, side scroll-wheel (for horizontal scrolling), and DPI switch

Button lifecycle: 3 million clicks


**Scroll Wheel:**

Standard optical encoder

Rubber-coated


**Power:**

Built-in rechargeable lithium battery

Capacity: 800mAh 

Charging port: USB-C

Charging time: 2-3 hours

Battery life: 20-25 days (4-5 hours daily use)

Standby time: 3-4 months

Low battery indicator: Yes (LED flash)

Charging indicator: Yes (LED color change)


**Physical:**

Dimensions (LxWxH): 95 x 60 x 35 mm

Weight: 65-75 grams

Form factor: Mini / Compact

Material: Plastic

Mouse feet: PTFE (smooth gliding)


**Compatibility:**

Windows 7/8/10/11

macOS 10.10 and above

Chrome OS

Android 5.0 and above

iOS 13 and above


**Software:**

Rapoo Options (Windows only)

No driver required for basic use

No on-board memory


**What's in the Box:**

MT760 Mini mouse

Nano USB receiver

USB-C charging cable

User manual


**Warranty:** 1 year


**Pros:**

Compact and portable

Multi-mode (5 devices)

Built-in rechargeable battery

USB-C charging

6 DPI levels


**Ideal for:**

Laptop users

Travel

Small to medium hands

Office work

Students

Multi-device users
